strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Enter at the price level of the candle that makes the liquidity grab after price briefly breaks support or resistance and then reverses. For longs, use the liquidity-grab candle at support; for shorts, use the liquidity-grab candle at resistance.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab and take profit at a recent swing level in the opposite direction: recent high for longs, recent low for shorts.

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all time frames; examples shown on multiple charts including 15-minute
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Base form uses the liquidity grab itself; optional confluences are discussed separately
variants.target_note: Take profit at a recent high or recent low depending on direction
variants.transcript_quote: you would enter here set your stop loss right right below the liquidity grab and you're going to set your take profit at a recent high

variants.timeframe_note: Daily-timeframe statistic discussed, but concept presented as an optimization rule
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Prefer liquidity grabs with peaks closer than 10 candles apart
variants.target_note: Same target method as base strategy
variants.transcript_quote: if you want optimal entries you should look for liquidity grabs with Peaks closer together

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Add momentum divergence as confluence alongside the liquidity grab
variants.target_note: Same target method as base strategy
variants.transcript_quote: we combine both the powers of the Divergence and the bullish liquidity grab and it gives us a higher probability of working in our favor

variants.timeframe_note: Example uses 15-minute entry chart with 1-hour higher-timeframe check
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Only take the liquidity-grab reversal when it occurs at the top or bottom of a higher-timeframe range/support-resistance
variants.target_note: Do our normal stop loss and take profit
variants.transcript_quote: we move back to the 15-minute time frame and do our normal stop loss and take profit

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches one core liquidity-grab reversal entry/exit skeleton; the 10-candle rule, divergence, and higher-timeframe support/resistance are compatible confluence variants, not separate strategies.
